# matharena

Inspect tasks reproducing [MathArena](https://matharena.ai)'s final-answer pipeline (reference implementation:
[eth-sri/matharena](https://github.com/eth-sri/matharena), MIT, whose parser and competition configs are included
unchanged). Vendored here so the apex benches (`matharena/apex_2025`, `matharena/apex_shortlist`) install offline.
